verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's review tools let an analyst add a document to a blocklist, which then programmatically blocks future verifications made with that same document (docs-11). The docs also say Stripe's systems work to detect fraudulent verifications (docs-17). Duplicate-document detection therefore starts with a manual step, and nothing describes cross-session face matching or automatic flagging of the same identity under different names. Missing for 10: automatic duplicate/repeat identity detection without manual blocklisting, selfie/face deduplication across verifications, detection of the same document under different names, independent corroboration.
